"'''Mother'''" was the codename of a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Spy/Legends|operative]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Working out of [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]],<ref name="Vendri" /> the Rebel's hidden [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> she was responsible for recruiting her fellow Duros [[Vendri DeRalm]] as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for the Alliance<ref name="Vendri" /> around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">The [[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|''Takeover at Whisper Base'']] Adventure Book notes that the roleplaying campaign [[Takeover at Whisper Base|mission]] occurs just after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and that the characters were recently recruited.</ref> Instead of giving her real name, she only used her codename of "Mother" when contacting DeRalm.<ref name="Vendri" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Mother" was mentioned in Vendri DeRalm's Character Folio included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.<ref name="Vendri" />
